relationships.subject: AB120
relationships.evidence_quote: AB120 attenuated paclitaxel-induced mechanical hypersensitivity at all tested doses compared to PBS-treated mice

relationships.subject: AB120
relationships.evidence_quote: ABT120 (5 mg/kg, i.p.) suppressed paclitaxel-induced mechanical hypersensitivity in WT but not CB2 KO mice

relationships.subject: AB120
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2 antibody agonists, AB110 and AB120, decreased the expression of M1 macrophage associated pro-inflammatory mRNA (TNF-α, NOS2, IL-6, IL-1β and CCL4)

key_findings: CB2-specific antibody agonists AB110 and AB120 reduced paclitaxel-induced mechanical and cold hypersensitivity without tolerance; AB120 effect was absent in CB2 KO mice and preserved in tumor-bearing mice.
